A newline-only inline wrapper still separates the words on either side

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "Alpha<span style=\"white-space:pre\">\n</span>13", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
